evidence.quote: We then feed these descriptions into the pre-trained BioLinkBERT (Yasunaga et al., 2022) model, and use the resulting class token embeddings as f LLM ( c )

decisions.rationale: R3: BioLinkBERT is a pretrained LLM module.

evidence.quote: We use learnable d dimensional embeddings to represent each class, f cls ( c ) = h c .

decisions.rationale: R3: learnable class embeddings use table lookup.

decisions.chain_element: concatenation of measures of source modality X source and target modality X target

evidence.quote: let X = [ X source , X target ] be the concatenation of measures of source modality X source ∈ R n,m s

decisions.rationale: R6: explicit concatenation is represented by concatenate.

decisions.chain_element: estimate expression levels of target modality from the input modality

evidence.quote: Modality prediction aims to estimate expression levels of target modality from the input modality.

decisions.rationale: R1: this element states the evaluation task performed by the model.

evidence.quote: This graph is constructed such that each edge represents the number of shared gene ontology terms (Ashburner et al., 2000) between each pair of genes, which reflects their functional similarities.

decisions.rationale: R0: the element names the graph data object; its construction is not stated in the chain element itself.

evidence.quote: The gene perturbation embeddings are then computed using simple graph convolution (SGC) (Wu et al., 2019), f GEARS ( c ) = SGC ( c , G ) .

decisions.rationale: R3: graph convolution is a named convolution/message-passing computation without a catalog operation.

evidence.quote: We use a linear mapping W ∈ R m × d to project the noised gene expression x t ∈ R m into R d

decisions.rationale: R3: a linear mapping named in the element is represented by project.

evidence.quote: and further mix it with the sinusoidal time embedding (Appendix B.1) to inject diffusion time step information, following previous work (Ho et al., 2020).

decisions.rationale: R3: sinusoidal time embeddings are positional/time encodings inside the model.

decisions.chain_element: use annotated scRNA-seq data as a reference

evidence.quote: This task typically requires some external reference, in most cases using annotated scRNA-seq data as a reference

decisions.rationale: R1: this element states the external reference data setup.

decisions.chain_element: estimate the proportions of different cell types

evidence.quote: Cell type deconvolution is to estimate the proportions of different cell types within mixed-cell spatial transcriptomics data.

decisions.rationale: R1: this element states the downstream evaluation task.

evidence.quote: We follow Lopez et al. (2018) and mix in an additional learnable batch embedding with the latent embedding according to the batch label of the input cell.

decisions.rationale: R3: a learnable batch embedding is represented by table lookup.

evidence.quote: We process the context condition similarly as the input embedding using a linear projection, but without the time embedding: f ctxt (˜ x ) = ˜ xW ctxt .

decisions.rationale: R3: the named linear projection is represented by project.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Graph convolution/message passing uses graph adjacency and neighborhood aggregation, which is not represented by the feature-only project operation.
